scope: Protein MD preparation and numerical readiness, plus a corrected three-replica 1 ns GB3 pilot against 225 published scalar couplings. This pilot fails its sampling criteria and establishes neither equilibrium convergence nor general protein stability or activity prediction.
experimental_conditions: 2–4 mM GB3 in 50 mM potassium phosphate, pH 6.5–7.0, 97/3 or 95/5 H2O/D2O, 0.5 mg/mL sodium azide; source-specific measurements at 298 K

modeled_conditions.buffer_approximation: Monovalent NaCl approximates the experimental potassium-phosphate buffer; isotopes, azide and concentration differ.

pilot.timing_scope: Scheduled output included. Numerical checks briefly overlapped replica 2; these rates are operational observations, not a controlled performance comparison.

native_checks.scope: CPU/CUDA agreement at identical prepared coordinates using predeclared tolerances; native CUDA checkpoint restoration with zero propagated steps. These controls do not establish force-field accuracy, equilibrium sampling or bit-identical continuation.

preparation_checks.scope: Atom-count and charge consistency plus nearest translated protein images over lattice coefficients -2 through 2 at two snapshots. Periodic electrostatic finite-size effects and separation over the full trajectory need separate assessment.

naming_correction.scope: Geometric IUPAC beta-methylene assignment, independent of measured values; source observations and molecular trajectories unchanged. Each assignment is checked in every saved frame. Other atom groups retain exact-name matching.

sampling.interpretation: Only 300 saved frames across the pilot; capped combined ESS cannot reach 400. The longer-sampling criterion is preserved. Replicas share one prepared source conformation; matching replica statistics alone would not establish global equilibrium.

independent_forward_model_audit.scope: Source-table projection, independent projected-vector cosine arithmetic on all 300 saved pilot frames and two static-conformation references. Atom paths use the declared resolved topology; the separate handedness audit remains necessary.
independent_forward_model_audit.interpretation: Static structures are references, not equilibrium ensembles. Backbone Karplus parameters in the 2015 source were fitted partly to GB3 data with assumed 10-degree fluctuations. Neither static nor MD agreement is a fully independent generalization test; no coefficients or observations were refitted here.
